## Headline Statistics (for 2024)

```{r}

  color = "info",
  value = round(statewide_dll, 0)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 that are DLL in MA"

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(statewide_percent, 2)
)
```

## Second heading

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of DLL children that Head Start serves in MA"

dll_hs <- headstart_dll_ma|>
  filter(pir_year == 2024)
headstart_dll <- dll_hs$total_dll_enroll

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = headstart_dll
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are DLL in MA"

hsswdllprop <- headstart_dll/statewide_dll

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hsswdllprop, 2)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent of dual language learners in MA that Head Start serves"

headstart_total <- dll_hs$total_child_enroll

hsdllprop <- headstart_dll/headstart_total

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hsdllprop, 2)
)
```

#Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
#| fill: false

options(scipen = 999)
ed_totals_under_5 |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(homeless_children = sum(HOMELESS_UNDER_5_GRADE_1, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(POPULATION_UNDER_5, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         homeless_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ homeless_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(homeless_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population)),
         ,
      percent_homeless = homeless_children / total_population * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_homeless, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Homeless Children",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Homeless Population via Grade 1 Proxy, ",
                     min(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END), 
                     "-" , 
                     max(ed_totals_under_5$YEAR_END))) +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_homeless, 2)), 
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
# 1. Change in statewide proportion of dual language learners aged 0-5
ggplot(non_e_517_ma, aes(x = year, y = percent_non_e, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners, Massachusetts, 2008-2024") +
  theme_minimal() 

# 1a. Comparing nationwide
ggplot(non_e_517, aes(x = year, y = percent_non_e, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Nationwide Proportion of Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners, United States, 2008-2024") +
  theme_minimal() 

# 2. Proportion of statewide total DLL covered by Head Start
ggplot(ma_dllenroll, aes(x = TimeFrame, y = dll_prop, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start",
       title = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start, Massachusetts, 2021-2024") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2a. 
ggplot(usa_dllenroll, aes(x = TimeFrame, y = dll_prop, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start",
       title = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start, United States, 2021-2024") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Proportion of Head Start children that are dual language learners
ggplot(headstart_dll_ma, aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_dll, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Percent of Head Start Students that are Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Head Start Proportion of Dual Language Learners, Massachusetts, 2021-2025") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3a. Comparison to United States: Head Start DLL Enrollment percent
ggplot(headstart_dll_states, aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_dll, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Percent of Head Start Students that are Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Head Start Proportion of Dual Language Learners, United States, 2021-2025") +
  theme_minimal()
```
